structured_field_evidence.interpretation: White random noise would give lag-1 autocorr ~0 and a flat spectrum; here the residual is a smooth structured field (lag-1 0.71-0.93) that differs per image. Library 'noise_spatially_correlated' is disabled, and even that operator is content-independent. The dominant degradation is out-of-library (moire/interference/screen-capture-like structured artifact).

noise_6step_check.diagnosis: No reliable random-noise signature. Pair0: noise_prior sigma=1.98 < 2 and SKILL rule says NO_NOISE; extreme_pct=47.26% is just below the documented JPEG/blur-residual FP band (extreme_pct>50% + sigma<5 -> ignore IMPULSE), and spatial_corr=0.987 proves the residual is a coherent field, not impulse/speckle/poisson. Pair3: var_slope<0 and vm_slope<0 exclude poisson/speckle; spatial_corr=0.905 and cross_ch_corr=0.928 indicate structured deterministic residual; extreme_pct=74.66% is inflated by the mean bias of an un-peeled residual (target-clean mean=-13.7). The library Gaussian floor (sev1 sigma=12.75) gave verify_signals WEAK with sigma mismatch 253%. Conclusion: NO library random noise; residual is the out-of-library structured interference.

final_decision.rationale: The five support pairs share a dominant degradation that none of the x_distortion operators can reproduce: a coherent quasi-periodic chromatic interference/moire-like field, warped and content-dependent, present over the entire frame. Every library candidate (JPEG 1/3, gaussian blur 1, contrast 1/3, brightness darken 1, gaussian noise 1) stays at or below the clean-vs-target no-op PSNR, because the structured pattern dominates the MSE. Per SKILL, all candidates <30 dB -> POOR and alternatives left empty. The honest library answer is 'no library pipeline'; the closest single fit (compression_jpeg:1, 21.54 dB) is statistically indistinguishable from doing nothing and is not believed to be the true degradation.
